content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The summary shows no substantive evidence behind the merits finding: no witness statements, comparator information, or management explanations for the accepted claims (a), (b), (k)-(q). The only ROI material is a stray reference to a witness and Complainant reporting to the Inspector General. The agency accepted a hostile work environment theory, yet incidents (c)-(f) and (h)-(j) were set aside as untimely background and claim (g) was dismissed, and the record does not show whether they were considered as part of the overall pattern. The agency also challenged the timeliness of the appeal without a record that it gathered enough information to support a reasoned timeliness determination. The final decision's conclusion cannot be evaluated from this record, so these gaps should be filled before a merits decision."}
